headline: Severe storm warning — coastal areas on alert
content: National meteorological service issues severe storm warning for coastal regions.

additional_updates.content: Wind speeds expected to reach 90km/h; authorities urge residents to stay indoors.
Ferry services suspended until further notice.

headline: Factory fire — industrial district evacuated
content: Large fire broke out in a chemical storage facility at 09:15 local time.

additional_updates.content: 500-metre exclusion zone established; 12 workers treated for smoke inhalation.

headline: Rail strike — national network disrupted
content: 24-hour strike by rail workers begins midnight Monday; most intercity routes suspended.
